play.definition: A special-teams recovery play in which the receiving team uses a hands-team alignment and coordinated recovery technique to secure a deliberately short kickoff after the ball becomes legally recoverable, while nearby teammates screen or block coverage players away from the recovery point.

Action_AttemptRecovery.label: Attempt Recovery
Action_AttemptRecovery.definition: A player's deliberate effort to gain possession of a loose or kicked football by reaching, diving, falling on, trapping, or grasping the ball before an opponent secures it.

Action_KickApproach.label: Kick Approach
Action_KickApproach.definition: The kicker's controlled run-up or step sequence toward the football before making contact on a kickoff, onside kick, free kick, or placekick.

Action_KickBall.label: Kick Ball
Action_KickBall.definition: A kicker's action of striking the football with the foot to initiate a kickoff, field-goal attempt, extra-point attempt, free kick, or other legal kicking play.

Action_None.label: None
Action_None.definition: A temporal label used when the player is visible but is not performing any defined football action in the action taxonomy during the annotated interval.

Action_PreSnap.label: Pre Snap
Action_PreSnap.definition: The period before the snap when players are set in formation and no active play has begun.

Action_SecureRecovery.label: Secure Recovery
Action_SecureRecovery.definition: A player's successful establishment of clear possession and control of a previously loose or kicked football during a recovery attempt.
